verses.1: And the LORD said to me, “If Moses and Aaron stand before me, then I will not send them away from this people. They shall go away.”
verses.2: And it shall be as if they said to you, “We will go away.” And you shall say to them, “Thus says the LORD: For death will come upon death, and destruction will come upon destruction. For famine will come upon famine, and destruction will come upon destruction. And for destruction, there will be no end.”
verses.3: And I decreed that they should be punished with four kinds of punishment: the birds that die from hunger, and the dogs that carry away other animals. Also, the birds that fly in the sky, and all those creatures that live on the earth, will be destroyed for food or for destruction.
verses.4: And they were given over to destruction by all the kings of the earth, because of Menashe ben Yehizkiah, king of Judah. He did evil things in Jerusalem.
verses.5: For who will comfort you in Jerusalem? Who will help you, and who will ask for compensation for your losses?
verses.6: You have abandoned me, O LORD! Now go away from me. I will lay my hands on you and comfort you with my presence.
verses.7: And they were scattered across the lands of the earth. I destroyed my people from their paths; they never returned.
verses.8: They brought me from the depths of the sea. I was brought to them by a chosen one in the twilight. Suddenly, I found myself in a city amidst tears.
verses.9: Oh, pregnant woman! She was seven months old when her child was born. But she suffered and died before her children could be born. May Jehovah have mercy on them!
verses.10: Oh, my mother! Why did a man of enmity and hatred give birth to me? I am not a woman at all, and no one will respect me. They all curse me.
verses.11: The LORD said, “If you have not been blessed with good things, if I have not helped you in times of trouble and distress, then you are indeed unfortunate.”
verses.12: It’s made of iron, forged from iron.
verses.13: Your army and your spoils will be given to me, without any price or cost. For all your sins and all your transgressions.
verses.14: And I have carried your sufferings through the land, without you knowing that fire was burning in my nostrils against you.
verses.15: You know, LORD, you remember me and protect me. Please forgive me for my persecutors. Do not let them take me away from you. May I be saved by your grace.
verses.16: Your words were found, and they became food for me. Your words brought joy to my heart, for your name was called upon by the LORD, the God of hosts.
verses.17: I will not sit in the place of those who play games. I will be angry at you alone. I will sit there because of your anger.
verses.18: Why was my pain eternal? My suffering became an endless torment. It would be like a lie from the sea; it never really existed.
verses.19: Therefore, as the LORD says: “If you return and I call you back before me, then you will stand before me. But if you bring something valuable from your treasures, just as it was before, then those who are with you will remain with them. And you will not return to them.”
verses.20: And You have given them to this people as a test of their faith. They will fight against You, but they will not be able to defeat You. For I am with You, and I will save You, says the LORD.
verses.21: And you were saved from the hands of the wicked, and you were delivered from the power of those who are evil.
